data.name: Lumory: A Distant Summer
data.detailed_description:
Lumory: A Distant Summer

Explore a bright, surreal world shaped by liminal spaces and distant summer memories.
Drift through soft blue-green environments inspired by early 2000s aesthetics—calm, open, and free from danger.

Glide with Your Childhood Scooter

Movement is at the heart of your journey.

Ride a childhood scooter—simple, familiar, and full of memory—now reimagined with smooth, weighty motion.
Glide across land, flow through open spaces, and even travel over water.

What once was a small object from the past becomes your way forward—
leading you to hidden paths and new perspectives.

See Beyond with Dream Vision

Reveal what cannot be seen.

With a single input, the world transforms—
hidden light emerges, paths shift, and impossible routes unfold before you.

A closed door may dissolve into light.
A distant space may suddenly become reachable.

Dream Vision is not just a tool—it's how you navigate the unseen.

Capture the Perfect Shot

Document your journey with a fully interactive in-game camera.

Frame quiet, surreal compositions and capture fleeting moments of light and space.
Each environment rewards patience, observation, and a sense of curiosity.

Explore and Interact

Wander freely through interconnected spaces designed like fragments of memory.

Collect nostalgic objects, store them in your inventory, and place them anywhere—
creating your own small, personal scenes within the world.

Shape the Atmosphere

Immerse yourself in a soft, ambient soundscape.

Play the original soundtrack or import your own music,
turning each session into a deeply personal experience.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 / RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 25 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700 / AMD Ryzen 7 3700X or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Ti / RTX 4060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
